## Merge main (PR #32) into fix/sonnet-5-cost-pricing to resolve conflict before… — 2026-08-31 (parent 5a92e5b2ae26)

**Merge PR #32 (main) into fix/sonnet-5-cost-pricing, bringing in the pending-set recompute fix for _ensure_fresh and three regression tests.**

This merge brings two changes from PR #32 into this branch.

In `trie/freshness:_ensure_fresh`, the `no_stamp`, `head_moved`, and `empty_store` rebuild paths now call `check_project` after scanning and write the pending stale set from scratch, rather than surfacing whatever entries happened to exist beforehand. This prevents phantom-stale entries from a prior `mtimes_moved` event from persisting into subsequent runs.

Three regression tests cover the fixed behaviour:

- `test_empty_store_computes_pending` — verifies the `empty_store` path calls `check_project` and `write_pending` so missing triefacts appear in the pending set.
- `test_head_moved_recomputes_pending` — verifies the `head_moved` path clears prior stale entries and does not resurrect them on the following `unchanged` run.
- `test_no_stamp_surfaces_missing_triefacts` — verifies that `ensure_fresh_before_turn` reports in-scope files as stale when no stamp and no triefacts exist.

### Changes

- + tests/test_freshness:test_empty_store_computes_pending — "Regression test: verifies that the `empty_store` rebuild path calls `check_project` + `write_pending`, so missing triefacts are recorded in the pending set and surfaced on the subsequent `unchanged`…"
- + tests/test_freshness:test_head_moved_recomputes_pending — "Regression test: verifies that the `head_moved` freshness path rewrites the pending set rather than preserving phantom-stale entries from a prior `mtimes_moved` event."
- + tests/test_freshness:test_no_stamp_surfaces_missing_triefacts — "Assert that `ensure_fresh_before_turn` reports in-scope source files as stale when no stamp exists and no triefacts have been written."
